about.title: Long
about.intro: {project} em i wanpela nupela jenereisen peer-to-peer fail serim platpom i bin wokim long ol nupela teknoloji i no gat wanpela senta. Em i bungim wanpela isi yusa interfes wantaim wanpela arkitekja i no gat wanpela senta olgeta, em i givim wanpela sevpela na trastim rot bilong serim dato i no gat sampela senta atoriti. Projek em i open source na em i go aut aninit long {license}.

decentralized.title: Netwak i no gat wanpela senta olgeta
decentralized.description: I no gat ol senta seva, i no gat wanpela ples we i ken pundaun. Ol yusa i painim na daunlotim ol samting stret namel long ol yet, i no nidim ol senta indekser, traka o database.

accessControl.title: Liklik liklik kontrol bilong akses
accessControl.description: Olgeta wanwan i fri long statim em yet netwak wantaim ol lo bilong em yet. Tokaut long ol rol bilong yusa long olgeta wanwan netwak: ol papa, ol admin, ol pablisa, ol moderata na ol daunlota. Kontrolim stret husat i ken pablisim, moderatim na daunlotim ol samting.

ui.title: Bikpela kwaliti yusa interfes
ui.description: Wanpela klin na isi long yusim midia senta interfes em i bin wokim bilong desktop, TV na mobile platpom. Wokabaut isi wantaim kibod, maus, gamepad o rimot kontrol. Ol strongpela yusa i ken yusim komand lain interfes long yusim sopwea olsem wanpela hedles fail seva.

dataFormat.title: Dato pomet man i ken ridim
dataFormat.description: Dato pomet bilong LISH em i sanap long JSON, em i mekim isi long wokim, ridim na undastendim. Serim ol samting bilong yu wantaim klia, opin metadata we olgeta wanwan i ken lukluk isi.

security.title: Praivet na sekiuriti
security.description: Olgeta peer-to-peer komunikesen em i enkripted, em i mekim sua dato bilong yu i stap praivet long taim bilong transpa. Ol yusa i ken haitim baksait long wanpela VPN bilong wanpela ekstra leia bilong i no save nem. {project} i rispektim praiveti bilong yu long disain.

crossPlatform.title: Kros platpom
crossPlatform.description: Sopwea em i avelibol long Windows, Linux na macOS platpom. Yusim long olgeta wanwan tul yu laikim.

download.title: Daunlot
download.description: Kisim {project} bilong platpom bilong yu. Olgeta daunlot em i fri na open source.
